
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- 05_stress_max_pins.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp8266` to volt.toml: chip = "esp8266"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp8266
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- 05_stress_max_pins.volt:4[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 0 must be HIGH during boot. If LOW, chip enters flash/programming mode.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin p0: Output = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- 05_stress_max_pins.volt:5[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 2 must be HIGH at boot. Often connected to onboard LED.

 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin p0: Output = 0
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin p2: Output = 2
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- 05_stress_max_pins.volt:11[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 15 must be LOW during boot. If HIGH, chip boots from SD card (not flash).

 [dim]10 |[/dim]     pin p14: Output = 14
 [dim]11 |[/dim]     pin p15: Output = 15
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]
